static_traits.name: 潘琪
static_traits.occupation: 同时Holds three jobs at the same time
static_traits.marital_status: 已向交往三年的Female友求婚（Unmarried）
static_traits.social_status: 有密友可交流，但尚not yet向他们谈及自己的自卑与Anxiety；工作压力与筹备求婚影响了与伴侣的关系
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往not yet经历类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性Good、配合度高；语气中性，能进行自我Reflection；自我批判明显，常use“应该”句式；在练琴场景中呈现灾难化、过度概括与非黑即白的认知倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 在音乐能力（尤其是吉他）方面感到not足与自卑，练习新歌曲时反复受挫，甚至认为自己永远not会成为好的Musician。
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks counseling out of awareness that this inferiority is affecting self-esteem and overall well-being, hoping to improve this state.

special_situations.event: 这周练习时not yet能顺利弹完两首新歌
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我连两首歌都练not成，就说明我注定not会成为好的Musician
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Watches tutorials and practices daily; when frustrated, sometimes forces continuing, sometimes simply stops practicing to avoid more sense of failure

special_situations.event: 练习新歌曲时出现错误与卡顿
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should be able to play well right now; if I am still making mistakes, it means I am terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressures and criticizes oneself to promote progress; if pressure is too great, avoids or interrupts practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 为什么还not会？我现在应该更好了

special_situations.event: 在三份工作与筹备求婚的高压力下开始练习
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能同时把工作、关系与练琴都处理好，就说明我总体not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to push through and keep practicing to prove oneself; choosing to avoid or stop when the pressure is too great
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这太多了，I cannot do anything well

special_situations.event: Friends affirm her playing, but she recalls the frustration of learning new songs more strongly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 有任何困难都意味着总体not行；好的表现not具代表性
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视或淡化正向反馈，只盯住错误与失败片段
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好表现not算数，真正说明问题的是我的失败

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为有能力的Musician，并在重要他人面前保持胜任与价值感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心让自己与伴侣失望
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与回避降低失败暴露，维持安全感与Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易失败的初学者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者（内在化的高标准与批评声音）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes her successful segments or positive feedback and invites her to acknowledge her ability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识认为这些正向证据与其“I am not good enough”的内在叙事相矛盾，感觉被要求“粉饰现实”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和、支持性语气反映其感受；not与其叙事对抗，先Empathy其Anxiety，再以小步探询的方式邀请其具体化正向证据。避免直接纠正，use开放式问题与具体化引导。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes structured practice and a recording plan and asks her to test her beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感到被要求证明自己，若做not到会被评判；于是以外在压力（工作与筹备求婚）为由推迟或淡化任务
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持中性与not评判的语气，承认其客观负荷；协助将任务切分为更小的可达成单元，采用共同拟定与选择的措辞，强调可选项与节奏感，减少被控制感。

manifestations: 同时承担三份工作与筹备求婚，主观体验为“被责任压得喘not过气”
When practicing piano, held hostage by the rule 'should be better', feeling my space for self-choice shrinking

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Self-demands such as 'I should be better' and 'I should have mastered it by now' frequently appear in one's language
将without误、迅速掌握作为评价自我价值的标准

contact_model.definition: 个体克制向外表达行为或需求的冲动，转而对自己做，将原本对外的能量Turning against the self，与“冲动”对应。
manifestations: Stopping practice when frustrated, turning criticism and pressure toward oneself (self-blame and shame)
not向朋友表达not足与Anxiety，选择独自承受

exception_events.target_problem: 当尝试学习新的吉他曲目时，来访者通常会感到Anxiety并产生Self-denial（如“我永远not会成为好Musician”），有时因此中断练习。
exception_events.unique_outcome: When playing familiar songs, experiencing smooth playing and confidence; friends praise her performance and say they like listening to her play.
exception_events.reason: 线索：曲目难度与熟练度匹配、已有掌握经验；获得他人积极反馈与支持，降低了Anxiety并增强了胜任感。

positive_force: Has actions for practice and self-improvement (watching tutorials, practicing daily)
朋友的正向反馈与潜在支持网络
Willing to try new methods and self-observation (open to behavioral experiments)
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括与非黑即白的认知模式
高负荷的外在压力（三份工作与筹备求婚）
在挫败时倾向回避或中断练习
Sleep and diet affected导致精力与韧性下降
对困扰not向亲友表达，获得支持的渠道not yet被充分利用

target_behavior.behavior: 在学习新曲目时出现Anxiety并中断练习
antecedent: 练习新歌曲时出现错误或卡顿
外在高压力（同时Holds three jobs at the same time与筹备求婚）
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次或一周的失败灾难化、过度概括为“永远not行”，并在资源负荷较大时注意力与耐受度下降。
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败感与Anxiety等not适，短期降低压力（负Reinforcement）。
target_behavior.consequence: 练习时间与质量下降，自信心与Impaired self-esteem，进一步Reinforcement“我not行”的信念，影响睡眠与饮食，并波及工作与关系。

target_behavior.behavior: Self-critical inner speech (such as 'I should be better', 'I am so terrible')
antecedent: 在预设时间内not yet掌握新曲目
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection的高标准与价值条件：将表现等同于自我价值，use“应该”规则维持控制感。
target_behavior.function: 试图以自我施压促进表现（表面目的），但实质维持负性图式与Anxiety水平。
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety上升与Decreased motivation，增加回避与中断练习的概率，并使整体福祉受损。
